structured_output.what_is_happening: A cluster of "Maxwell Ramstead" ($MAX) tokens launched within about 2 hours, apparently set off by a Beff Jezos (@beffjezos, Guillaume Verdon, the e/acc founder) X post that links to or mentions Maxwell Ramstead (@mjdramstead). Ramstead is an active-inference researcher, Chief Science Officer of Noumenal Labs, and has appeared with Verdon on MLST. This contract (91vPo…) is about 15 minutes old. It launched on a Meteora virtual curve and migrated right away. It has pumped 288-333% on about 976 unique buyers against 74 sellers. It is not the leading token in the cluster: AzMa… came about 28 minutes earlier and has $229k market cap and $1.9M of volume in the last hour. rNwC… (a pump.fun coin) and CfcE… are also larger or close to it.

narrative.description: A Beff Jezos post about Maxwell Ramstead set off a burst of 'name the person' memecoins. Beff has a large crypto and e/acc following, so even a passing mention can start a short-lived frenzy of copies.
narrative.why_spreading: Beff Jezos's reach, plus quick-copy launches across pump.fun and Meteora. There is no underlying event beyond one post, and Ramstead is a niche academic figure.

token_connection.why_this_token: It uses the same name and ticker and links the same Beff Jezos status as its twitter field. Nothing shows it has any endorsement. The GMGN image-duplicate count is 3.
token_connection.competing_tokens: AzMa… (earliest of the cluster by about 28 minutes, $229k market cap, $1.9M volume in the last hour: the likely leader), rNwC…pump ($161k), CfcE… ($88k), 21Ry… 'mjdramstead' (the first one, now dead at $6.6k), plus several dead copies.

authenticity.evidence: There are many unique buyers (976 in 15 minutes) and a strong buy/sell skew, but GMGN flags 34 bundler wallets and 15 snipers. There are no paid boosts, no smart-money wallets and no KOL wallets. The attention comes from one post, spread across many copy tokens.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read the X post (the fetch returned HTTP 402), so I don't know if Beff actually endorses any contract.

structural_risks: 99.99% of LP is unlocked (RugCheck 'danger'), so the deployer can pull liquidity
One holder owns 80% of supply and has no label. GMGN puts the top-10 share at 4.8%, which suggests that wallet is a pool vault, but I could not confirm that
Liquidity is only $26.6k against $130k market cap
Buyers are split across 3+ competing same-name tokens, and this one is not the leader
The creator has launched 2 tokens; the best one peaked at $182k

structured_output.counterargument: Momentum is still accelerating: 443 buys against 82 sells in the last 5 minutes and roughly 1000 unique buyers. If the Beff Jezos meme grows (for example if Ramstead or Beff responds), even secondary copies in these clusters often double from $130k, and this one sits near the leader's market cap.
unknowns: What the Beff Jezos post says and whether it names a contract

Whether Ramstead or Beff has responded

source_coverage.notes: Tight time budget. One web search confirmed who Ramstead is and his link to Beff Jezos. The X status fetch returned HTTP 402. I did not open the usepaid.app link.

structured_output.thesis: A derivative same-name token in a fast Beff Jezos meme cluster. Demand is strong right now, but this token is not the canonical one, its LP is unlocked and it has bundler activity. Its chance of running is below that of the cluster leader and about average for the pool.
